definitions.gloss: model, type, make (of a machine or device)
definitions.explanation: A specific model or type of machine, device, or equipment. Most commonly used for electronics such as smartphones, computers, and cameras, as well as aircraft types.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{機種|きしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えたい→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to switch to a new model.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{機種|きしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}している→終了する：22990_shuuryousuru⟧。
examples.english: This model has already been discontinued.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: When switching smartphone models, don't forget to transfer your data.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in technology and consumer electronics contexts. The compound {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう} (changing to a new device model, abbreviated as {機種|きしゅ}{変|へん}) is especially frequent for smartphone upgrades. Also used for aircraft types in aviation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}: changing device model (especially phones)
- {対応|たいおう}{機種|きしゅ}: compatible/supported models
- ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧{機種|きしゅ}: latest model
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{機種|きしゅ}: popular model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{型番|かたばん}→型番：22103_kataban⟧: model number (more specific, refers to the alphanumeric designation)
- ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧: device, equipment (the device itself, not the model type)
